verdicts.reason: A uses the banner well, with the headline on one line and the CTA on the right. But the CTA is jammed against 'price' and runs past the green panel's right edge. The 48H ONLY badge has shrunk into a tiny squashed oval where '48HONLY' can't be read, and the panel's bottom edge crowds the body copy. B is worse. The headline wraps badly on a wide banner and leaves 'price' alone on its own line, the body copy leaves 'stock.' alone on its line, and the CTA is tiny and weak. The badge is stretched into an oval that hangs off the panel edge, and the centred text block doesn't line up with anything, which leaves dead space.
